clause.quote: Codes in the large Count Code table MUST be each 8 characters long.

description: After the genus/version code the stream holds only --JAAA, six characters of an eight-character count code. The specification has no sentence saying such a stream must be rejected; the assertion rests on the cited MUST, which this stream violates, so it cannot be decoded as a conforming stream. Any rejection satisfies the assertion; the class in the note is informative.
title: Reject a stream that ends inside a large count code
